statement: ∀ (m n k : ℕ) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (_hm : 2 ≤ m) (_hk : 2 ≤ k) (hkn : k ≤ n) (_hx_nonneg : ∀ i : Fin n, 0 ≤ x i) (_hx_antitone : ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≤ j → x j ≤ x i) (_h_sum_pow : 1 ≤ (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m)) (_h_sum : (∑ i : Fin n, x i) ≤ (k : ℝ)), 1 ≤ (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i))
proofTerm:
by
  intro m n k x hm hk hkn hx_nonneg hx_antitone h_sum_pow h_sum
  classical
  let t : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)
  let kidx : Fin n := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
  let u : ℝ := x kidx
  change 1 ≤ t
  by_contra hnot
  have htlt : t < 1 := not_le.mp hnot
  let front : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.image (Fin.castLE hkn)
  let tail : Finset (Fin n) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i ∉ front)
  have hsum_front_x : (∑ i ∈ front, x i) = t := by
    dsimp [front, t]
    refine Finset.sum_image ?_
    intro a ha b hb hab
    apply Fin.ext
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hab
    simpa [Fin.castLE] using hv
  have hpartition_x : (∑ i ∈ front, x i) + (∑ i ∈ tail, x i) = ∑ i : Fin n, x i := by
    have h := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := Finset.univ) (p := fun i : Fin n => i ∈ front) (f := x)
    simpa [tail, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter] using h
  have hsum_front_pow : (∑ i ∈ front, (x i) ^ m) = ∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m := by
    dsimp [front]
    refine Finset.sum_image ?_
    intro a ha b hb hab
    apply Fin.ext
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val hab
    simpa [Fin.castLE] using hv
  have hpartition_pow : (∑ i ∈ front, (x i) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) = ∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m := by
    have h := Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := Finset.univ) (p := fun i : Fin n => i ∈ front) (f := fun i : Fin n => (x i) ^ m)
    simpa [tail, Finset.filter_mem_eq_inter] using h
  have htail_le_x : (∑ i ∈ tail, x i) ≤ (k : ℝ) - t := by
    all_goals nlinarith [hpartition_x, hsum_front_x, h_sum]
  have hterm_le_t : ∀ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ≤ t := by
    intro i
    dsimp [t]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j hj => hx_nonneg (Fin.castLE hkn j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hu_nonneg : 0 ≤ u := by
    dsimp [u]
    exact hx_nonneg kidx
  have hu_le_t : u ≤ t := by
    let jlast : Fin k := ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    have hcast : Fin.castLE hkn jlast = kidx := by
      ext
      all_goals simp [jlast, kidx, Fin.castLE]
    have h := hterm_le_t jlast
    all_goals rw [hcast] at h
    simpa [u] using h
  have hfirst_ge_u : ∀ i : Fin k, u ≤ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) := by
    intro i
    have hle : Fin.castLE hkn i ≤ kidx := by
      change (Fin.castLE hkn i).val ≤ kidx.val
      all_goals simp [kidx, Fin.castLE]
      all_goals omega
    have hanti := hx_antitone (Fin.castLE hkn i) kidx hle
    simpa [u] using hanti
  have htail_facts : ∀ i : Fin n, k ≤ i.val → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u := by
    intro i hik
    constructor
    · exact hx_nonneg i
    · have hle : kidx ≤ i := by
        change kidx.val ≤ i.val
        all_goals simp [kidx]
        all_goals omega
      have hanti := hx_antitone kidx i hle
      simpa [u] using hanti
  have hfirst : ∀ i : Fin k, 0 ≤ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ∧ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ≤ t := by
    intro i
    exact ⟨hx_nonneg (Fin.castLE hkn i), hterm_le_t i⟩
  have source_step_0 :
      t < 1 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, 0 ≤ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ∧ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ≤ t) ∧
      (0 ≤ u ∧ u ≤ t) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin k, u ≤ x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin n, k ≤ i.val → 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ u) := by
    exact ⟨htlt, hfirst, ⟨hu_nonneg, hu_le_t⟩, hfirst_ge_u, htail_facts⟩
  have htail_mem : ∀ {i : Fin n}, i ∈ tail → k ≤ i.val := by
    intro i hi
    have hi_not : i ∉ front := by
      dsimp [tail] at hi
      simpa using hi
    by_contra hlt
    have hltk : i.val < k := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hlt
    let j : Fin k := ⟨i.val, hltk⟩
    have hji : Fin.castLE hkn j = i := by
      ext
      all_goals simp [j, Fin.castLE]
    have hmem : i ∈ front := by
      dsimp [front]
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ j, hji⟩
    exact hi_not hmem
  have source_step_1 : (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := by
    have htail_pow_le : (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * (∑ i ∈ tail, x i) := by
      calc
        (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) ≤ ∑ i ∈ tail, u * x i := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hik : k ≤ i.val := htail_mem hi
          have hfacts := source_step_0.2.2.2.2 i hik
          have hx0 : 0 ≤ x i := hfacts.1
          have hxu : x i ≤ u := hfacts.2
          have hx_le_t : x i ≤ t := le_trans hxu source_step_0.2.2.1.2
          have hx_le1 : x i ≤ 1 := le_trans hx_le_t source_step_0.1.le
          have hpow2 : (x i) ^ m ≤ (x i) ^ 2 := by
            calc
              (x i) ^ m = (x i) ^ (2 + (m - 2)) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hm]
              _ = (x i) ^ 2 * (x i) ^ (m - 2) := by rw [pow_add]
              _ ≤ (x i) ^ 2 * 1 := by
                exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ hx0 hx_le1) (sq_nonneg (x i))
              _ = (x i) ^ 2 := by ring
          have hx2_le : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ u * x i := by
            calc
              (x i) ^ 2 = x i * x i := by rw [pow_two]
              _ ≤ u * x i := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxu hx0
          all_goals linarith
        _ = u * (∑ i ∈ tail, x i) := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    calc
      (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) ≤ u * (∑ i ∈ tail, x i) := htail_pow_le
      _ ≤ u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail_le_x source_step_0.2.2.1.1
  have source_step_2 : ∀ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m ≤ (1 + u) * x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - u := by
    intro i
    have hfirst_i := source_step_0.2.1 i
    have hx0 : 0 ≤ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) := hfirst_i.1
    have hx_le_t : x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ≤ t := hfirst_i.2
    have hx_le1 : x (Fin.castLE hkn i) ≤ 1 := le_trans hx_le_t source_step_0.1.le
    have hu_le_x : u ≤ x (Fin.castLE hkn i) := source_step_0.2.2.2.1 i
    have hpow2 : (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m ≤ (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ 2 := by
      calc
        (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m = (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ (2 + (m - 2)) := by rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hm]
        _ = (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ 2 * (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ (m - 2) := by rw [pow_add]
        _ ≤ (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ 2 * 1 := by
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_one₀ hx0 hx_le1) (sq_nonneg (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)))
        _ = (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hsquare_le : (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + u) * x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - u := by
      have hprod : (x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - u) * (x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - 1) ≤ 0 := by
        exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hu_le_x) (sub_nonpos.mpr hx_le1)
      have hprod_expand : (x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - u) * (x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - 1) = (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ 2 - u * x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - x (Fin.castLE hkn i) + u := by ring
      all_goals nlinarith [hprod, hprod_expand]
    all_goals linarith
  have hsum_const_u : (∑ i : Fin k, u) = (k : ℝ) * u := by
    all_goals rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    all_goals simp [nsmul_eq_mul]
  have source_step_3 :
      (∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m) ≤ (1 + u) * t - (k : ℝ) * u ∧
      (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m) ≤ t := by
    have hfront_pow_le : (∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m) ≤ (1 + u) * t - (k : ℝ) * u := by
      calc
        (∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m) ≤ ∑ i : Fin k, ((1 + u) * x (Fin.castLE hkn i) - u) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          exact source_step_2 i
        _ = (1 + u) * (∑ i : Fin k, x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) - ∑ i : Fin k, u := by
          all_goals rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = (1 + u) * t - (k : ℝ) * u := by
          all_goals rw [hsum_const_u]
          all_goals simp [t]
    refine ⟨hfront_pow_le, ?_⟩
    have htotal_decomp : (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m) = (∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) := by
      calc
        (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m) = (∑ i ∈ front, (x i) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) := by rw [← hpartition_pow]
        _ = (∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) := by rw [hsum_front_pow]
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m) = (∑ i : Fin k, (x (Fin.castLE hkn i)) ^ m) + (∑ i ∈ tail, (x i) ^ m) := htotal_decomp
      _ ≤ ((1 + u) * t - (k : ℝ) * u) + u * ((k : ℝ) - t) := by
        exact add_le_add hfront_pow_le source_step_1
      _ = t := by ring
  have source_step_4 : False := by
    have htotal_lt : (∑ i : Fin n, (x i) ^ m) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_lt source_step_3.2 source_step_0.1
    exact (not_lt_of_ge h_sum_pow) htotal_lt
  exact source_step_4

sourceSteps.sourceExcerpt: 第一步，令 t=∑_{i=1}^k x_i，u=x_k。反设 t<1。由于 x_i≥0 且这前 k 项之和小于 1，对每个 1≤i≤k 都有 0≤x_i≤t<1；同时 0≤u≤t/k<1，并且前 k 项均满足 x_i≥u，后 n−k 项均满足 0≤x_i≤u。
第二步，对于每个 i>k，由 m≥2 和 0≤x_i≤u<1，有 x_i^{m}=x_i·x_i^{m−1}≤x_i·u≤u x_i。故尾部幂和满足 ∑_{i=k+1}^n x_i^m≤u∑_{i=k+1}^n x_i≤u(k−t)，最后一个不等式使用 ∑_{i=1}^n x_i≤k。若 n=k，尾部为空和 0，此式仍成立。
第三步，对于每个 1≤i≤k，由 m≥2 和 0≤x_i<1，有 x_i^m≤x_i²。另一方面 u≤x_i<1，所以 (x_i−u)(x_i−1)≤0，即 x_i²−u x_i≤x_i−u。二式结合得到 x_i^m−u x_i≤x_i−u，即 x_i^m≤(1+u)x_i−u。

第四步，对前 k 项求和，得 ∑_{i=1}^k x_i^m≤(1+u)t−ku。与第二步的尾部估计合并，
∑_{i=1}^n x_i^m≤(1+u)t−ku+u(k−t)=t<1。
第五步，这与题设 ∑_{i=1}^n x_i^m≥1 矛盾。故假设 t<1 不成立，于是 t≥1，也就是 ∑_{i=1}^k x_i≥1。证明完毕。

goalExcerpt: 证明前 k 项之和 ∑_{i=1}^k x_i≥1。
